## Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? What's the scenario?

## Proposed Solution

How should this work? Be specific.

## Binary Size Impact

Will this increase the binary size? By roughly how much?

- [ ] No impact (docs, tests, config)
- [ ] Minimal (<1 KB)
- [ ] Small (1-5 KB) — needs justification
- [ ] Large (>5 KB) — needs discussion first

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?

## Would You Implement This?

- [ ] Yes — I'd like to submit a PR
- [ ] Maybe — I'd need guidance
- [ ] No — just suggesting

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or examples.
